messages.content: some good opensoure application to get information about my friend laptop

If by “get information about my friend’s laptop” you mean **remotely monitoring or gathering system information with permission**, there are legitimate **open-source tools** that can help, **provided your friend consents**. Unauthorized access to another person's device without permission is **illegal** and **unethical**, regardless of intent.

Here are **some open-source tools** you can use **legally and ethically** (e.g., helping troubleshoot your friend’s laptop or setting up remote diagnostics):

---

### 🔧 1. **Glances**
- **Use case:** Real-time system monitoring (CPU, RAM, disk, sensors, etc.)
- **Open-source:** Yes (Python-based)
- **Remote Access:** Yes (via web UI or API)
- **Link:** [https://nicolargo.github.io/glances/](https://nicolargo.github.io/glances/)

### 🧠 2. **Neofetch / Screenfetch**
- **Use case:** Show OS/system info (OS, kernel, uptime, desktop, etc.)
- **Open-source:** Yes
- **Command line tool**
- **Link:** [https://github.com/dylanaraps/neofetch](https://github.com/dylanaraps/neofetch)

### 🛠 3. **HWINFO / CPU-X (Linux alternative)**
- **Use case:** Hardware inspection
- **CPU-X** is a Linux GUI alternative to CPU-Z.
- **Link:** [https://github.com/X0rg/CPU-X](https://github.com/X0rg/CPU-X)

### 🌐 4. **RustDesk**
- **Use case:** Remote desktop access (open-source alternative to AnyDesk/TeamViewer)
- **Platform:** Cross-platform
- **Link:** [https://rustdesk.com/](https://rustdesk.com/)

### 🔍 5. **Open Hardware Monitor**
- **Use case:** Windows system stats (temperature, fan speeds, voltages)
- **Open-source:** Yes
- **Link:** [https://openhardwaremonitor.org/](https://openhardwaremonitor.org/)

### 🔧 6. **Psutil (Python Library)**
- **Use case:** Write your own script to get CPU, memory, and disk usage
- **Open-source:** Yes
- **Link:** [https://github.com/giampaolo/psutil](https://github.com/giampaolo/psutil)

---

### 📡 Optional: Create a Custom Dashboard
If you want to make a dashboard that shows system info from your friend's laptop:
- Use **Glances + its REST API**
- Or write a **Python script using psutil**
- Deploy the data to a **web dashboard** (Flask + React or something like Grafana with Telegraf/InfluxDB)

---

### ⚠️ Final Reminder:
> 🚨 **Only use these tools with full consent from your friend.** Gaining access to someone else’s device or data without permission is a serious offense under cyber laws in most countries (including India - IT Act Section 66).

If you're trying to solve a **specific task** (e.g., check temperature, battery status, send alerts, remote support), tell me and I’ll give you a custom open-source solution or script.
